letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or Ahmedabad whispers your name. As the gentle winter breeze drifts through our balcony, I find myself smiling at the thought of your laughter echoing in every corner of our shared world. You’re my cutie, my compass, the reason my heart dances even across time zones. Today, as the calendar turns, I’m reminded how lucky I am to walk this adventure hand‑in‑hand with you, forever and always.
poem:
In every desert dune and city street,  
Your love’s the rhythm that makes my heart beat.  
Across the skies, our souls entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
